corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from ninja.errors import HttpError
import uuid
from .models import DigitalContractEnvelope
from .schemas import ContractUploadSchema

esign_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@esign_router.post("/envelopes/{envelope_uuid}/executed-doc", response=ContractUploadSchema)
async def upload_executed_contract(request, envelope_uuid: uuid.UUID, signed_pdf: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    envelope = await DigitalContractEnvelope.objects.aget(uuid=envelope_uuid)

    # Verify that the caller is an active designated signatory on this envelope
    is_signatory = await envelope.signatories.filter(user=request.auth).aexists()
    if not is_signatory:
        raise HttpError(403, "Forbidden: you are not an authorized signatory for this envelope")

    file_bytes = await signed_pdf.read()
    await envelope.save_final_document(signed_pdf.name, file_bytes)

    return {"envelope_uuid": envelope.uuid, "status": "executed"}
